runners_data.name: Mistral St Georges
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who can avoid the early pace battle but recent form shows concerning falls and unseats

runners_data.name: Planters Punch
runners_data.note: Natural front runner with excellent recent form but amateur jockey may struggle to control the pace against Guts And Glory

runners_data.name: Longmoor
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who is lightly raced for Tizzard with only 20 days since last run, could have more to offer

runners_data.name: Evening Tess
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist perfectly suited to this pace scenario with solid trainer form and excellent record on similar going

runners_data.name: Guts And Glory
runners_data.note: Front runner with good recent form on soft ground but 27 days since last run may impact fitness edge

runners_data.name: Look Don't Stare
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who has been finishing poorly but the pace setup could mask her stamina concerns over 2m

runners_data.name: Whitletts
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid soft ground form but 59 days absence is a significant concern for sharpness

races.paceDynamic: Planters Punch and Guts And Glory will ensure a genuine gallop from the start, with both proven front runners likely to contest the early lead. Planters Punch brings stronger form credentials with back-to-back wins, while Guts And Glory showed honest pace-setting ability in his last two runs on similar ground. The sustained pace over 2m on soft ground will create opportunities for closers to pick up the pieces late. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and those that can finish, as the early leaders may struggle to sustain their effort against fresher finishers.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Collapse Late
scenarios.trigger: If Planters Punch and Guts And Glory go too hard early battling for the lead
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainable on the testing ground, allowing hold-up horses to sweep past tired leaders in the final furlong. Evening Tess and Look Don't Stare benefit most from this tactical setup despite their modest recent form.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Planters Punch Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Planters Punch gets an uncontested lead with Guts And Glory settling behind
scenarios.body: Henderson's charge can dictate a more manageable pace and kick clear when it matters, using his superior class and fitness advantage. His back-to-back wins suggest he's peaking at the right time.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is strong but not suicidal, creating ideal conditions for mid-pack horses
scenarios.body: Mistral St Georges and Whitletts can track the leaders without being caught up in the early battle, positioning perfectly for late strikes. Both have the tactical speed to capitalize when the front runners weaken.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longmoor Upset Special
scenarios.trigger: If the lightly-raced runner has been working better than his odds suggest at home
scenarios.body: Tizzard's charge could outrun his modest recent form, benefiting from the strong pace while having scope for improvement. His light racing background means there could be significant untapped potential.

watchPoints.text: Planters Punch and Guts And Glory could go too fast early if they clash for the lead, setting up the race for closers
Look Don't Stare has been fading badly in recent runs so even a strong pace may not be enough to revive her chances
Evening Tess has perfect conditions with her hold-up style and excellent record on soft ground making her dangerous at big odds
Longmoor is lightly raced which could mean improvement but also raises questions about his readiness for this level
The amateur jockey on Planters Punch may struggle to judge pace against more experienced riders in a tactical battle

races.name: Tiptop Duel Flush Mares' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Elated
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner returning from 79-day break with only modest form, but faces no pace pressure here

runners_data.name: Tenter Le Tout
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with excellent recent form and trainer striking at 25%, ideally placed tactically behind the leader

runners_data.name: Jollie Dame
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer from in-form Dan Skelton yard, consistent recent placings suggest readiness for breakthrough

runners_data.name: Lakeview Lass
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with concerning finishing record, trainer Jeremy Scott winless in last 6 attempts

runners_data.name: Footage Detectives
runners_data.note: Patient type with moderate ability, trainer Henry Oliver also struggling for winners recently

runners_data.name: Molten Sea
runners_data.note: Strong finisher carrying 7lbs penalty for recent win, form figures suggest genuine improvement this season

runners_data.name: Ciao Bellisima
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning from 89-day absence with poor finishing record intact

runners_data.name: Nowherenearmilan
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with modest recent form but headgear suggests connections trying to spark improvement

runners_data.name: Burning Embers
runners_data.note: Forward-going type from powerful Dan Skelton stable, recent runs suggest gradual decline in form

races.paceDynamic: Elated will take this race from the front without any serious early pressure, with Tenter Le Tout, Nowherenearmilan and Burning Embers settling just behind in the next rank. The lack of natural pace-pressers means Elated can dictate comfortable fractions throughout, creating a race where the real battle happens from the back of the field in the final half-mile. With most of the quality sitting deep - including Molten Sea, Jollie Dame and the prominent runners who can drop back - this sets up perfectly for strong finishers who can produce sustained rallies. This tactical scenario heavily favours hold-up horses with proven finishing kicks over those needing to race prominently.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Elated Controls Uncontested
scenarios.trigger: If Elated faces no early pressure and maintains comfortable splits throughout
scenarios.body: Brendan Powell can nurse his mount into the straight with energy reserves intact, making full use of his natural front-running style. The lack of pace pressure allows Elated to kick clear when the hold-up horses are still organising their challenges.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Finisher Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the soft going and modest pace allows the hold-up brigade to produce telling late rallies
scenarios.body: Molten Sea and Jollie Dame benefit most from the combination of their preferred patient tactics and the energy-sapping conditions that blunt Elated's finishing kick. The race becomes a war of attrition where stamina and timing matter more than early positioning.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tactical Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Tenter Le Tout or Nowherenearmilan track Elated closely then pounce before the back markers get organised
scenarios.body: The prominent pair can use their tactical speed to bridge the gap to Elated while the hold-up horses are still making ground from too far back. Chester Williams' 25% strike-rate with Tenter Le Tout suggests good placement.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Elated stops or significantly weakens in the final furlong after dictating throughout
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy scramble where any horse with a turn of foot can capitalise on the leaders' demise. Even the outsiders get a chance if the principals have emptied their tanks battling the testing conditions.

watchPoints.text: Elated could have this race sewn up turning for home if the 79-day absence hasn't dulled his fitness edge
Tenter Le Tout's positioning behind the leader is crucial - if Gingell lets him drift back the race changes completely
Molten Sea carries a 7lb winner's penalty which could prove decisive in a tight finish on testing ground
Both Henry Oliver runners Footage Detectives and Ciao Bellisima look vulnerable given the trainer's poor recent record
The Dan Skelton pair Jollie Dame and Burning Embers represent the yard's 22% strike-rate but show contrasting form trends

runners_data.name: Whatyouwaitingfor

runners_data.name: Dj Pete
runners_data.note: Lowest-rated but proven soft ground winner carrying bottom weight, capable of outrunning odds if others disappoint

races.paceDynamic: Ostend and Pep Talking will clash early as confirmed front runners, with Ostend's Tom Broughton (5lb claim) likely aggressive from the off. The honest gallop these two create over 2m should stretch the field, particularly on testing ground that will emphasize stamina. Koapey, Whatyouwaitingfor and Dj Pete will track prominently but may struggle to match the sustained pace. This setup strongly favours the patient hold-up horse Ballybreeze, whose style thrives when others commit early and fade late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Ballybreeze Swoops Late
scenarios.trigger: If the front two go too hard early and fade in the final half-mile
scenarios.body: Ballybreeze's hold-up style proves perfect as he picks off tired leaders, with Powell timing his run to perfection. The testing ground amplifies the advantage of his patient tactics over those who raced prominently.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Koapey or Whatyouwaitingfor can settle and quicken when the leaders tire
scenarios.body: The winner avoids the early battle but stays close enough to capitalize, benefiting from class and a tactical ride. Recent form suggests either could exploit a truly-run race.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pep Talking Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Pep Talking gets an uncontested lead while Ostend tracks rather than challenges
scenarios.body: With his headgear helping focus and solid recent form, Pep Talking maintains a steady rhythm to repel late challengers. The 7lb weight advantage over the main rivals proves decisive in a stamina test.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Ostend Guts It Out
scenarios.trigger: If Ostend's class overcomes the 5lb claiming jockey disadvantage in a tactical error
scenarios.body: Despite racing keenly early, superior ability and excellent going record see him hold off all challenges. The front-running style works if he can dictate terms rather than being pressured.

watchPoints.text: If Ostend and Pep Talking go too fast early, they'll set it up perfectly for Ballybreeze's trademark late surge
Koapey's jumping under pressure - any mistake when trying to match the pace could end his chances immediately
Tom Broughton's 5lb claim on Ostend looks a disadvantage if tactical decisions are needed in a rough race
Ballybreeze needs the leaders to go hard early to maximize his hold-up advantage from the back
Pep Talking's headgear change suggests connections expect him to settle better and use his natural speed more efficiently

races.paceDynamic: The Kemble Brewery stands as the sole confirmed front-runner and will be allowed to dictate terms from the start without early pressure. With seven prominent racers including Cosmic Connection, Authodidacte, and Celtic Art likely to settle just off the pace, there's significant firepower tracking the leader through the middle stages. Only Doctors Hill and Zambezi Fix are true hold-up horses in this small field. This race shape strongly favours the prominent racers who can position themselves perfectly behind The Kemble Brewery and strike when the pace lifts, rather than the lone leader who may get swamped or the hold-up horses who need a stronger gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack times their challenge perfectly as The Kemble Brewery begins to tire
scenarios.body: The strong group of seven prominent racers will have ideal positioning to launch coordinated attacks in the straight, overwhelming the tiring leader. This tactical setup perfectly suits horses who can travel well in behind before quickening.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader Holds Gamble
scenarios.trigger: If The Kemble Brewery gets soft fractions and kicks clear before the prominent pack reacts
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader builds an unassailable advantage through the gentle pace, leaving the prominent racers with too much ground to make up. David Bass's experience proves crucial in managing the tempo.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly searching and the prominent racers get involved in a speed duel
scenarios.body: The early pace quickens significantly as prominent racers jostle for position, setting up perfectly for Doctors Hill to produce his trademark late surge. The strong gallop plays to his patient style.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If no prominent racer wants to take on The Kemble Brewery until very late
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical crawl with everyone waiting, turning into a sprint finish where class and turn of foot matter most. This neutralizes running styles and favors pure ability.

watchPoints.text: The Kemble Brewery's fitness after 157 days off - if he shows early signs of rustiness the race complexion changes dramatically
Cosmic Connection's jumping under pressure - has fallen when favorite before and needs to be fluent at the business end
Authodidacte's ability to handle competitive handicap company after winning easier races in recent starts
Celtic Art's response to headgear being reapplied - could signal stable expects improved performance
How aggressively the prominent racers position themselves behind The Kemble Brewery in the early stages

runners_data.name: Happy And Fine

runners_data.name: The Boola Boss

runners_data.name: Buckna

runners_data.name: Gris Majeur
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with consistent form on good ground, but needs strong pace to be effective and may find this race run to suit front runners.

runners_data.name: Camulus

races.paceDynamic: Happy And Fine looks the only confirmed front runner and will set a sustainable tempo without early pressure from this field of prominent racers. The Boola Boss, Sizable Sam, Buckna, and Camulus will all settle just behind the leader, creating a compact group through the early stages. With only two hold-up horses (Gris Majeur and Choice Runner) and a manageable pace, this race will become a test of stamina and jumping in the final mile rather than a sprint finish. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and front runners who can maintain their position and kick when the pace lifts, rather than hold-up horses who need a strong gallop to close into.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Happy And Fine maintains an even gallop without serious challenge until the home turn
scenarios.body: The prominent racers get an ideal setup to time their challenge perfectly, with the race becoming a stamina test rather than speed battle. Horses with proven staying power like The Boola Boss and Buckna can use their class to prevail.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pressure Applied
scenarios.trigger: If Sizable Sam or The Boola Boss decide to press Happy And Fine from the third fence onwards
scenarios.body: The increased tempo will stretch the field and create gaps, potentially setting up the race for a hold-up horse to close strongly up the hill. Gris Majeur's superior finishing kick becomes a major weapon.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Dominates Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Happy And Fine jumps cleanly and maintains a strong rhythm that discourages challenges
scenarios.body: The front runner can use the soft ground and uphill finish to grind out victory, with only the classiest prominent racers able to get close. The pace becomes too honest for hold-up horses to make up ground.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If the leaders go too slowly and bunch up turning for home creating a cavalry charge finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint up the hill where stamina matters less than instant acceleration and tactical positioning. Fresh legs from hold-up horses or lightly-raced types could prevail.

watchPoints.text: Happy And Fine's jumping - any early mistakes will hand the initiative to prominent racers and completely change the pace dynamic
The Boola Boss and Sizable Sam's early positioning - if either decides to press the leader it will create a much stronger gallop
Gris Majeur's position turning in - needs to be within striking distance or the hold-up angle becomes irrelevant
Buckna's fitness after 44-day break - looked progressive before the layoff but needs to prove readiness first time back
The pace through the back straight - if it becomes crawling slow it opens the door for a blanket finish up the hill

races.paceDynamic: Presenting Doy will dictate from the front with no natural challenger for the early lead, setting a steady rhythm over this extended trip. The remaining five runners all show prominent tendencies but lack true pace-pressing instincts, meaning Presenting Doy gets an uncontested lead. This creates a tactical race where the tempo becomes moderate to slow, allowing hold-up horses to get into the race but making it difficult for prominent runners to find the right position. This race shape strongly favours either the confirmed front-runner or any horse capable of switching to hold-up tactics, as the lack of early pace will create a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Scores
scenarios.trigger: If Presenting Doy gets soft fractions and stays the extended trip
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows Presenting Doy to dictate at her own pace, with stamina reserves intact for the finish. Her proven front-running ability over similar distances makes her hard to peg back when getting her own way.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Kick Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the steady pace allows hold-up types to get competitive
scenarios.body: Harmony Heights benefits most from the slow tempo, getting the strong finish she needs to utilize her hold-up style. The lack of early speed plays directly into her preferred tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Form Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If I Am The Moon overcomes her inconsistency and gets the right trip
scenarios.body: Her recent soft ground form shows ability but the headgear and inconsistent jumping remain concerns. If connections have sorted her issues, the distance and ground suit perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes truly run and the pace collapses completely
scenarios.body: Love Me or Katie's Melody could benefit from a truly tactical affair where class tells in the finish. The lack of early pace allows them to get closer than usual to the leaders.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Presenting Doy gets headed early - she may not have the gears to respond if challenged for the lead
Monitor I Am The Moon's jumping - her headgear suggests ongoing issues that could end her chance at any obstacle
Check how quickly Love Me settles early - her tongue-tie suggests she needs to relax to be effective
Watch for any early pace injection from the prominent brigade - could completely change the tactical dynamic
Observe Katie's Melody's position turning in - she needs to be handy to have any chance given trainer's poor strike rate

races.paceDynamic: Inion Tiogair will be the lone early leader in this 14-runner field, setting a controlled pace without early pressure from the predominantly hold-up field. Hillwalk and Peace In The Park may track in second and third, but the majority including Shan't Wait, Thorgath, Sophie Power and Rapid Mission will settle towards the rear. With only one confirmed front-runner against 10+ hold-up horses, Inion Tiogair can dictate fractions and kick when ready, while the packed field behind creates traffic problems in the straight. This race shape strongly favours the early leader and prominent trackers who can avoid the inevitable late scramble.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leader Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If Inion Tiogair faces no early pressure and dictates steady fractions.
scenarios.body: The 9-year-old can time her effort perfectly while the massed ranks of hold-up horses get in each other's way turning for home. Her excellent soft ground record (14/15 runs, 2W6P) and tactical advantage become decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too slow and the field bunches entering the straight.
scenarios.body: A wall of horses hits the front simultaneously with Thorgath, Shan't Wait and Sophie Power benefiting from their superior class ratings. The strongest stayers prevail in a cavalry charge finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Nightmare
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates significant interference problems in the home straight.
scenarios.body: Several fancied runners get blocked or forced wide, allowing a horse with a clear run like Rapid Mission or Peace In The Park to strike. Clean passage becomes more valuable than raw ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Pair Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Hillwalk tracks Inion Tiogair closely and they break clear together early in the straight.
scenarios.body: The two prominent runners establish an unassailable lead over the struggling pack behind, with Hillwalk's fresher legs (3W3P in soft ground) proving decisive. The hold-up brigade never gets close enough.

watchPoints.text: Inion Tiogair must be allowed an uncontested lead - if challenged early by Hillwalk or Peace In The Park the race dynamic completely changes.
Traffic problems are inevitable with 13 runners funneling into Chepstow's straight - watch for hold-up horses getting blocked or forced extremely wide.
Thorgath carries top weight 168lbs in soft ground after 49 days off - monitor if the class horse can overcome the tactical disadvantage.
Several runners show fade-in-finish warnings (Bushstreet Bowman, D'Gesteevo, Triple Haych) making them risky at this extended trip.
Multiple 7lb claiming jockeys aboard (Daire McConville, Harry Atkins, Chad Bament, Harriet Tucker) - watch for inexperienced riders in traffic.
